_meta.title: Xinjiang internment camps and prisons
_meta.what: Locations of camps, detention centres and prisons used to hold Uyghurs and other Muslim minorities in Xinjiang, China, found by BuzzFeed News from satellite imagery, with how well each site is corroborated.
_meta.source: Alison Killing, Megha Rajagopalan, Christo Buschek / BuzzFeed News, Xinjiang Camps Data (version of 20 July 2021)
_meta.citation: BuzzFeed News (Killing, Rajagopalan, Buschek), Xinjiang Camps Data, 2021, CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/critocrito/xinjiang-camps-data
_meta.notes: All 551 rows kept. 'corroboration_level' values as published (corroborated, Satellite - strong/medium, sub-compound, Pre-2016 programme, closed, probably closed). 'aspi_2020_no' is the matching site number in ASPI's Xinjiang Data Project where BuzzFeed recorded one. File is cp437-encoded; decoded as such (Prefecture 'Ürümqi').
